---
title: "Module 13 · Scales and facets"
subtitle: "Grammar of Graphics III"
---

Scales decide how data become positions, labels and colors; facets split
one plot into panels. Both change what a reader can see, and whether every
reader can see it.

- **Practice with solutions:** [D1–D9 on penguins and gapminder](practice.qmd),
  the patterns behind every Guided Project task.
  Download: [exercises](files/practice_d1-d9.R) ·
  [solutions](files/practice_d1-d9_solutions.R).
- **Class scripts:** `live/` and `concepts/` in your
  `module-13-scales-facets` project in Posit Cloud.
- **Slides:** Slides are on Blackboard and in Posit Cloud (`slides/` in
  your `module-13-scales-facets` project).
- **Guided Project:**
  - [Instructions](guided-project.qmd): start here.
  - `gp13_starter.zip` is in Blackboard. You work in your own
    `cis-3901-projects` project and publish a report and slides on your
    own site.

**Readings (optional):** Wickham, Navarro & Pedersen, *ggplot2: Elegant
Graphics for Data Analysis* (3rd ed.),
[ch. 10](https://ggplot2-book.org/scales-position.html) (position scales
and axes), [ch. 11](https://ggplot2-book.org/scales-colour.html) (color
scales and legends) and [ch. 16](https://ggplot2-book.org/facet.html)
(faceting).
